programme.title: E2 - Tigers (Circus Tigers)
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. It’s an epic journey with traffic delays on the outskirts

The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. It’s an epic journey with traffic delays on the outskirts

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Lung and his daughter Ying are each other's only dependence. Despite the huge debt left by his ex-wife, Lung believes in good karma for good people, until he loses his beloved daughter in a kidnap while travelling in Thailand. Lung abandons all his faith. He marries a Thai Chinese, Lan, and starts a new life in Thailand. However, he never leaves the past behind. All these years he has been gathering information of the kidnap gang, and vows to take justice into his own hands at any cost...

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: By a strange twist of fate, dutiful Hong Kong policeman Dave Wong saves the life of the leader of a violent gang of armed robbers. When they commit another crime, Dave is determined to put an end to their activities. He works with the leader, whom the gang had betrayed, to engineer a plan to wreak havoc within the gang and let the gangsters kill one another. But it becomes increasingly obvious to Dave and to his colleagues that Dave is suffering from a severe mental disorder, and Dave finds that instead of upholding the law as a righteous police officer, he has now become a fugitive wanted for murder.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: A vicious killer Feng is going round Hong Kong killing top martial arts exponents, leaving a secret weapon called the Moonshadow as his calling card. When convicted killer and kung fu expert, Xia, hears of this, he offers to help the police catch the killer, in return for his freedom. Despite their misgivings, the police release the former police martial arts instructor into their custody. With his help, they realize from the chronological order of the victims that the killer is targeting his victims, all the top masters in their martial arts style, following a martial code of training. When Xia also disappears after a close encounter with Feng, they suspect the worse...

programme.title: She’s Got No Name
programme.desc: Set in a bustling alleyway during the Japanese occupation of Shanghai in the 1940s, the film centres on a wife, Zhan Zhou, who was being charged with the bloody dismemberment of her husband – a killing that seems impossible for her to have committed alone. The murder thrusts Zhan into the spotlight and the court of public opinion, forcing her towards a fate intertwined with that of her own country.

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: Chaos By Design
programme.desc: Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends...

programme.title: United We Stand
programme.desc: Alias “Springing Gazelle”, the renowned athlete Miss Chi Cheng is in Hong Kong helping to organize a training programme and hunt for a coach. Olivia was a former brilliant sprinter who has to give up running after her injury in a competition. At the beginning of the training, the girls are too pompous that they despise Olivia, until they find that Olivia is beyond their challenge, they adore her and are willing to go through the hardship but after a winning contest, they feel hostility towards each other and behave proudly. As a result, they lost in the competition with Singapore team. Olivia is so furious...

programme.title: Why, Why, Tell Me Why
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious...

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: The story is set in the Ming dynasty. 'Holy Sword' requests a fight with secret agent 009's friend 'God of Sword' to decide the world's best swordsman. During the contest on the roof of the Forbidden City, 009 realises that 'Holy Sword' has sent a double to fight in his place, while he plans to assassinate the emperor. 'Holy Sword' finds himself surrounded by thousands of palace guards but is rescued by 'God of Sword', who wants to complete their championship...

programme.title: Taoism Drunkard
programme.desc: In the Taoist Temple of Dragon Tiger Mountain, there lived a Drunken Taoist whose behavior and appearance were different from ordinary people. He was punished to find a virgin boy who was born in the year of 'Sun Mou', the 15th of August of midnight for the consecration of new idol. In order to find that virgin boy, he was unfortunately involved in a murdering case. Many years ago, in the Science Clan, there was a Starry Devil who was cruel and brutal and often committed the rules of the Clan. On one occasion, while he was trying to steal the Leader's Writ, he was being discovered and punished by peeling off his hand's skin then expelled out of the Clan. Wu's grandmother was one of the executors and also the protector of the writ...
